title: E-Commerce Platform
description: A full-featured e-commerce platform designed from the ground up. It includes robust user authentication, a dynamic product catalog, and secure payment processing through the Stripe API. The goal was to create a seamless shopping experience for users and an easy-to-manage dashboard for administrators.

title: Interactive Data Dashboard
description: An analytics dashboard that provides real-time visualization of complex data sets. Using D3.js, it transforms raw data from a REST API into interactive charts and graphs, allowing users to intuitively explore trends and insights.

title: Community Forum Web App
description: A real-time community forum built with Vue.js and Google Firebase. Features include live topic updates, user profiles, and a markdown-enabled post editor to foster community engagement.
